references.text: Delilah repeats her question to Samson about the secret behind his strength, showing her persistent attempt to uncover his weakness.
Delilah continues to ask Samson how he can be bound, as part of her repeated efforts to deceive him.
Delilah presses Samson further, and he finally reveals the secret of his hair and his Nazirite vow.
A similar pattern where a woman uses persuasion and tears to get Samson to reveal a secret, as with the riddle at the wedding feast.
The proverb warns against being led astray by a woman's flattery and persuasion, reflecting Delilah's tactics toward Samson.
